title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
brief: OpenAI received Trump administration clearance to publicly release GPT-5.6, which CEO Sam Altman called the company's best model ever. Simultaneously, OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work, an AI agent combining ChatGPT and Codex capabilities powered by GPT-5.6 (Sol, Terra, and Luna variants) for non-technical users to automate non-coding tasks.
